define_common_args: define common argparse arguments for data loading including dataset type, scene scale, and normalization options
build_data_options: build a dictionary of data options from parsed args to pass as kwargs to the dataset constructor
maybe_merge_config_file: load a JSON config file and merge its arguments into the parsed args namespace
setup_render_opts: setup SparseGrid renderer options by copying render arguments from parsed args to the renderer opt object
review_config_util: review the config_util module functions for argument parsing, config merging, and render option setup
